$comment: Maps conformance client checks to canimcp capability ids (data/spec-versions.json). A check takes the capability of the first rule whose pattern matches its id; a check no rule matches takes its scenario's default. INFO checks are trace lines and are not mapped. Ids under `proposed` are not in spec-versions.json yet.

checks.note: Cross-cutting: every message the client sent validated against the spec schema for the run's version. Kept in the record, not a capability of its own.
Retry after UnsupportedProtocolVersion is the 2026-07-28 negotiation path.

absence.$comment: Checks that pass when the client does nothing: they fail only if the client does a forbidden thing. A failure counts. A pass counts only next to a passing check of the same capability in the same run that is not on this list, so a client that ignores the feature, or throws, cannot get a status from them alone.

checks.note: SUCCESS when the client did not call the tool with that invalid header definition.
SUCCESS when the client listed skills and read no skill file.
SUCCESS when the canary URL was not fetched.
SUCCESS when the client did not retry. A client that rejects the result (Python SDK 2.3.0) passes too.

notTestable.$comment: Checks the suite emits as FAILURE with an errorMessage starting 'Not testable:' (details.untestable) when the client never reached the behaviour under test. They are left out of the evidence and listed under notTestable in the summary.

proposed.protocol.requestMeta: SEP-2575: per-request _meta (protocolVersion, clientCapabilities, clientInfo) in the 2026-07-28 stateless lifecycle. spec-versions.json describes it in protocol.initializeHandshake's notes but has no id for it.
proposed.authentication.oauth.scopes: Scope selection and step-up (WWW-Authenticate scope, scopes_supported, omission, retry limit, SEP-2350 union on re-auth).
proposed.authentication.oauth.refreshTokens: SEP-2207 refresh-token guidance: offline_access only when the AS supports it.
proposed.authentication.oauth.dpop: SEP-1932 DPoP-bound tokens. The suite tags the scenarios as an extension.
proposed.authentication.oauth.workloadIdentityFed: SEP-1933 JWT-bearer grant from a workload identity. Extension-tagged in the suite.
proposed.oauthClientCredentials: Alias for the io.modelcontextprotocol/oauth-client-credentials extension, which has no alias in extensions.known, so its features have no id root.
proposed.enterpriseManagedAuthorization: Alias for the io.modelcontextprotocol/enterprise-managed-authorization extension, same gap.
proposed.jsonSchemaDialect: JSON Schema handling: 2020-12 keywords kept intact (SEP-1613) and no network $ref dereferencing (SEP-2106). spec-versions.json has the dialect history as its top-level jsonSchemaDialect section, not a capabilities key, and the registry records dialects under jsonSchema without a status.

notCovered.$comment: Client capabilities in spec-versions.json that no client scenario in this suite version exercises.
